columns.name: session_id
columns.description: Session ID.

columns.name: block_id
columns.description: The block.

columns.name: block_name
columns.description: The block's own name, where the source has one.

columns.name: clock_id
columns.description: The clock the interval's ticks are on.

columns.name: start_tick
columns.description: First tick of the block.

columns.name: stop_tick
columns.description: Last tick of the block, inclusive.

columns.name: reward_probability_left
columns.description: Left reward probability across the block.

columns.name: reward_probability_right
columns.description: Right reward probability across the block.

columns.name: metadata
columns.description: What the source stated about this row that the standard does not model, carried in the source's own vocabulary and read by no rule.

rules.sql: SELECT session_id, block_id FROM dynamic_foraging.blocks WHERE stop_tick < start_tick

rules.message: two blocks of one session overlap, so a trial falls in both
rules.sql: SELECT a.session_id, a.block_id, b.block_id AS other FROM dynamic_foraging.blocks AS a JOIN dynamic_foraging.blocks AS b ON a.session_id = b.session_id AND a.block_id < b.block_id WHERE a.start_tick <= b.stop_tick AND b.start_tick <= a.stop_tick

rules.message: a trial names a block whose interval does not contain it
rules.sql: SELECT t.session_id, t.trial_id FROM dynamic_foraging.trials AS t JOIN dynamic_foraging.blocks AS b ON b.session_id = t.session_id AND b.block_id = t.block_id JOIN core.intervals AS c ON c.session_id = t.session_id AND c.interval_kind = t.interval_kind AND c.interval_id = t.trial_id WHERE c.start_tick < b.start_tick OR c.stop_tick > b.stop_tick

columns.name: session_id
columns.description: Session ID.

columns.name: base_reward_probability_sum

columns.name: iti_min

columns.description: Longest inter-trial interval.

columns.name: response_duration
columns.description: How long a response is accepted for.

columns.name: reward_consumption_duration
columns.description: How long the animal is given to drink.

columns.name: reward_delay
columns.description: Delay between a correct response and delivery.

columns.name: left_valve_open_time

columns.name: right_valve_open_time
columns.description: Calibrated open time for the right valve.

columns.name: session_alternation

columns.name: auto_train_curriculum_name
columns.description: Curriculum the trainer was running.

columns.name: auto_train_curriculum_version

columns.name: auto_train_curriculum_schema_version
columns.description: The schema version that curriculum was written to.

columns.name: auto_train_stage
columns.description: Stage within the curriculum.

columns.name: auto_train_engaged

columns.name: auto_train_stage_overridden
columns.description: Whether an experimenter overrode the stage the trainer chose.

rules.message: a minimum exceeds its maximum, so nothing can be drawn from the range
rules.sql: SELECT session_id FROM dynamic_foraging.sessions WHERE block_min > block_max OR delay_min > delay_max OR iti_min > iti_max

rules.message: a curriculum stage is named with no curriculum to place it in
rules.sql: SELECT session_id FROM dynamic_foraging.sessions WHERE auto_train_stage IS NOT NULL AND auto_train_curriculum_name IS NULL

columns.name: session_id
columns.description: Session ID.

columns.name: interval_kind
columns.description: Always `dynamic_foraging.trials`. Carries `core.intervals.interval_kind` as part of the shared key, so the reference to `core.intervals` covers that table's whole key. Not a discriminator: it resolves nothing a consumer of this row does not already know.

columns.name: trial_id
columns.description: The trial, and the interval it occupies in core.

columns.name: block_id
columns.description: The block this trial falls in. Blocks are derived from where the reward probabilities change, since the source records no boundary.

columns.name: animal_response
columns.description: Which way the animal responded. The source emits 0, 1 and 2; the writer decodes them, because a code whose key is not in the packet leaves no rule, query or reader able to tell one response from another.

columns.name: rewarded_history_left
columns.description: Whether the left port paid out.

columns.name: rewarded_history_right
columns.description: Whether the right port paid out.

columns.name: bait_left
columns.description: Whether reward was baited on the left.

columns.name: bait_right
columns.description: Whether reward was baited on the right.

columns.name: reward_probability_left
columns.description: Left reward probability in force. Constant within a block, which is what blocks are derived from.

columns.name: reward_probability_right
columns.description: Right reward probability in force.

columns.name: reward_random_number_left
columns.description: The draw the left outcome was decided by, so a reanalysis can reproduce it.

columns.name: reward_random_number_right
columns.description: The draw the right outcome was decided by.

columns.name: delay_start_tick
columns.description: When the delay began.

columns.name: go_cue_start_tick
columns.description: When the go cue played.

columns.name: reward_outcome_tick
columns.description: When the outcome was delivered or withheld.

columns.name: delay_duration
columns.description: The delay this trial drew. Constant where the session's delay_beta is zero.

columns.name: iti_duration
columns.description: The inter-trial interval this trial drew.

columns.name: auto_water_left
columns.description: Whether the left port delivered unearned water.

columns.name: auto_water_right
columns.description: Whether the right port delivered unearned water.

columns.name: lickspout_position_x
columns.description: Lickspout position.

columns.name: lickspout_position_y
columns.description: Lickspout position.

columns.name: lickspout_position_z
columns.description: Lickspout position.

rules.message: the go cue precedes the delay it is supposed to follow
rules.sql: SELECT session_id, trial_id FROM dynamic_foraging.trials WHERE delay_start_tick IS NOT NULL AND go_cue_start_tick IS NOT NULL AND go_cue_start_tick < delay_start_tick

rules.message: the outcome is recorded before the go cue
rules.sql: SELECT session_id, trial_id FROM dynamic_foraging.trials WHERE reward_outcome_tick IS NOT NULL AND go_cue_start_tick IS NOT NULL AND reward_outcome_tick < go_cue_start_tick
SELECT session_id, trial_id FROM dynamic_foraging.trials WHERE NOT reward_probability_left BETWEEN 0 AND 1 OR NOT reward_probability_right BETWEEN 0 AND 1

rules.message: a reward random number falls outside 0-1, so the outcome cannot be reproduced
rules.sql: SELECT session_id, trial_id FROM dynamic_foraging.trials WHERE NOT reward_random_number_left BETWEEN 0 AND 1 OR NOT reward_random_number_right BETWEEN 0 AND 1

rules.message: a port paid out where nothing was baited
rules.sql: SELECT session_id, trial_id FROM dynamic_foraging.trials WHERE (rewarded_history_left AND NOT bait_left) OR (rewarded_history_right AND NOT bait_right)

rules.message: a block's trials disagree about the reward probabilities, so the block is not one
rules.sql: SELECT session_id, block_id FROM (SELECT session_id, block_id, COUNT(DISTINCT reward_probability_left) AS l, COUNT(DISTINCT reward_probability_right) AS r FROM dynamic_foraging.trials WHERE block_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY session_id, block_id) AS derived_1 WHERE l > 1 OR r > 1
